peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 6.4% below its local comparables; 51 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (31.4): 2.3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 121 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 5). Context, not scored: resales in 25% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $3,080,000 ($2,121 psf, 1,334–1,668 sq ft; 5 resales, Mar 2024–Feb 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,266 psf (range $1,018–2,774); 6.4% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $211,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Tanjong Rhu MRT about 320 m, Stadium MRT about 770 m; closer than 497 of 662 similar developments (the same as 7). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 0 within 2 km; nearest Kong Hwa School about 2,530 m; more than 0 of 662 similar developments (the same as 125). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 760 m), more than 93 of 662 similar developments (the same as 38); nearest hawker centre Golden Mile Food Centre about 1,030 m; nearest park East Coast Park Area A about 320 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 4 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Aurea, 39 new sales, about 890 m; Midtown Bay, 4 new sales, about 1,470 m; Midtown Modern, 1 new sales, about 1,520 m; Arina East Residences, 85 new sales, about 1,570 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 71 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 129 new sales and 296 resales (425 purchases); new sales were 30.4% of these purchases. Subsales (27) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Tanjong Rhu Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,050 m; Kallang Close GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,780 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 296 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 55 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 296 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 316 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6.3%). Planning-area private resales −11.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
